title: Windsurf: Features, Pricing & How to Use It | God of Prompt

facts.fact: Per this page, the Windsurf Pro plan costs $20 per month.
facts.quote: Pro is $20/mo, Max is $200/mo for the highest quotas, and Teams is $40 per user.

facts.fact: Per this page, the Windsurf Max plan, offering the highest quotas, costs $200 per month.
facts.quote: Pro is $20/mo, Max is $200/mo for the highest quotas, and Teams is $40 per user.

facts.fact: Per this page, the Windsurf Teams plan costs $40 per user.
facts.quote: Pro is $20/mo, Max is $200/mo for the highest quotas, and Teams is $40 per user.

facts.fact: Per this page, Windsurf's free tier includes light quotas and unlimited tab completion.
facts.quote: Free tier with light quotas and unlimited tab completion.

facts.fact: Per this page, unlimited tab autocomplete is available on every Windsurf plan, including the free plan.
facts.quote: Unlimited tab autocomplete on every plan, including free.

facts.fact: Per this page, Windsurf dropped its credit system in 2026 in favor of a daily and weekly quota model.
facts.quote: A desktop editor that in 2026 dropped credits for a daily and weekly quota model.

facts.fact: Per this page, Windsurf (formerly Codeium's product) is now part of Cognition.
